title: Mochizuki Honami — Just Get Over This Feeling〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day of the solo show
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is it. Our show's really happening. I'm so nervous...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even after going on and on last night during our group call saying, “I'm so excited! I can't wait!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Because I was!
I'm so excited that my heart's going crazy right now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I understand how she feels. We walk down this street all the time, but it seems different today for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It shouldn't seem so unfamiliar, but it does. What an odd sensation.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You seem totally fine, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Aren't you nervous...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I think I am... But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have a lot to do when we get to the live house, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My head's been occupied by that all since yesterday... That may be why I'm not feeling that nervous or anxious.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, Honami, that makes sense knowing you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Hona, I'll help you with all the thinking if you share half of my nervousness!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, half of it might be a lot...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't forget about my nervousness, Honami. Here, have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think she's okay, actually.

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Ichika, Honami & Saki
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Good morning!
We've been looking forward to today for quite some time!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Yes, so have I.
So, let's get down to business by starting with ticket sales.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, here is our reservation list.
I've placed the remaining advance tickets in this envelope.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll use this to update my list.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Also, about our timetable and set list...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, look! Hona's like a cool businesswoman♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I mean, Honami is Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can hear you two...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. We wanted you to hear us♪
Just kidding...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you...

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Welcome, Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: We're gonna run a sound check now, right? We'd like to start with the drums, so if you can get ready for us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, be right there!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, want me to help?

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Haha. Thanks, but we should be able to handle it!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: You're here as a member of Leo/need today, Hinomori. You can leave the checks to us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: No problem! You can count on us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, Saki, they're probably gonna run a bass check next, so I'll stay here and get ready for that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Then, we'll be in the green room.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, Hona, see you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, see you soon!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you starting to feel nervous...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that shouldn't be a problem. Our sound check should distract me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know. I'm not all that worried about you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, the sound from your bass drum has felt different lately.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm? Do you think so?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is just my gut feeling, but I think it has more presence... You sound clearer and more accurate.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? But it's not like I've changed my technique or anything...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, regardless of the actual reason, the way you're currently drumming makes it really easy to play along. Even more than before.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, were you trying to get me to feel less nervous...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not really. I was just telling you what was on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
The drums are all set!
We're ready to start the sound check!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, coming!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, have fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I will!
